recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中央有十餘顆成熟中性球聚集成團（neutrophil aggregation），另有多處大片不規則的紅血球凝集塊與小球形紅血球；中性球被聚集時儀器計數會偏低，造成假性中性球低下。
features: Large cluster of about 15 mature segmented neutrophils aggregated together
Additional small groups of 2-3 neutrophils nearby
Irregular large clumps of agglutinated red cells throughout the field
Many small dense spherocytes/microspherocytes among individual red cells
Occasional echinocyte; individual neutrophils morphologically unremarkable
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large aggregate of approximately 15 mature segmented neutrophils, along with smaller neutrophil clusters. The background contains numerous irregular clumps of agglutinated red cells and many small dense spherocytes, consistent with the stated Coombs-positive immune hemolytic anemia. The neutrophils themselves appear morphologically normal without blasts or dysplasia. Findings are consistent with in vitro neutrophil aggregation causing spurious (pseudo)neutropenia on automated counts; a manual differential, a smear from a non-EDTA or warmed sample, and review of the analyzer flags are recommended.

ddx.vs: True neutropenia shows few neutrophils evenly distributed on the smear without clumps, and counts remain low in citrate or warmed samples.
Platelet clumps are aggregates of small anucleate granular fragments, not nucleated segmented neutrophils.
Rouleaux are orderly stacks of red cells like coins, whereas agglutination forms irregular three-dimensional clumps as seen here.

ddx.dx: Circulating tumor or leukemic cell cluster
ddx.vs: Tumor clusters contain large atypical cells with high N:C ratio and nucleoli, while this cluster is composed of normal mature neutrophils.
